export_evidence: ImportKey company pages exist for both name variants but expose zero shipment rows without login. Page for https://importkey.com/countries/india/zf-commercial-vehicle-control-systems-india-limited states only: "Shipments available for ZF COMMERCIAL VEHICLE CONTROL SYSTEMS INDIA LIMITED, refreshed daily" — a marketing placeholder, not a record. Same for https://importkey.com/countries/india/wabco-india-ltd ("Shipments available for WABCO INDIA LTD, refreshed daily"). Rows actually seen: 0 of 0. No bill-of-lading number, date, destination or HS code was visible on any accessible page.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or contract line could be retrieved: BSE page (https://www.bseindia.com/stock-share-price/zf-commercial-vehicle-control-systems-india-ltd/wabcoindia/505872/) returned only the site shell ("LIVE Stock/Share Market | Indian Stock/Share Market LIVE | BSE SENSEX"), screener.in returned HTTP 404, zaubacorp returned HTTP 403. Rows actually seen: 0.
note: Evidence gap, not a negative finding. The company is the listed Indian entity formerly WABCO India Ltd (ZF group, Chennai/Ambattur), so real domestic supply and exports are highly likely, but I could not open a single customs/B-L or GST/tender record within the tool budget: DuckDuckGo search backend was down ("searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused") for all queries, and volza, eximpedia, trademo returned HTTP 403 while importgenius served a JavaScript challenge. Therefore export_status and domestic_status are set to unknown rather than confirmed — no shipment is asserted and none is denied. Declared HS codes 842139/848110/848120/848140 (valves, filters, pressure regulators) are plausible for this manufacturer but were not verified against any shipment line, so no HS correction is proposed. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in accessible sources). Recommend re-run with a working search backend or a paid customs-data view before any verdict.
